title: "heterozygosity_analysis"
format: 
  pdf: 
    toc: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))
```

```{r}
# Load the data
heterozygosity <- read.delim("heterozygosity_stats.het", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% 
  rename("ivip" = "INDV") %>%
  rename("observed_heterozygosity" = "O.HOM.") %>%
  rename("expected_heterozygosity" = "E.HOM.") %>%
  rename("inbreeding_coef" = "F") %>%
  rename("n_sites" = "N_SITES")
```

```{r}
ivip_order = 
  heterozygosity %>% 
  arrange(desc(inbreeding_coef)) %>%
  pull(ivip)

heterozygosity %>% 
  mutate(ivip = factor(ivip, levels = ivip_order)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = ivip, y = inbreeding_coef)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Heterozygosity by IVIP",
       x = "Genotype",
       y = "Inbreeding coefficient")
```
